# Truncated SHA-256 digests of the ID-shaped Go test function names present at
# the baseline commit, one per line, sorted. Together with
# go-test-func-baseline.txt these account for every function the baseline had:
# 1361 behavioural names plus the 169 digested here.
#
# Digests rather than names on purpose. The names are the residue this story
# exists to remove, so committing them in plain text would put 169 fresh
# underscore-form scenario IDs into the tree and no residue gate could pass
# again. A digest pins the same fact without naming it.
#
# To resolve an entry in approved-test-deletions.txt whose function was renamed
# before it was deleted, take the name it had at baseline and hash it:
#
#   printf %s 'TheNameItHadAtBaseline' | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16
#
